exams.name: First Division Examination (Fundamentals of Engineering)
exams.notes: Tests knowledge of fundamental engineering subjects including mathematics and basic sciences. Board may waive for substantially qualified applicants. Required for engineer-in-training certification.
exams.jurisdiction: national or state; administered per board arrangements
exams.quote: The first division of the examination shall test the applicant's knowledge of appropriate fundamental engineering subjects, including mathematics and the basic sciences

exams.name: Second Division Examination (Principles and Practice of Engineering)
exams.notes: Tests ability to apply knowledge and experience in professional practice; includes state laws/board rules section, and for civil engineers also includes seismic principles and engineering surveying principles.
exams.jurisdiction: national or state; administered at least once per year per branch
exams.quote: the second division of the examination shall test the applicant's ability to apply their knowledge and experience and to assume responsible charge in the professional practice of the branch of engineering in which the applicant is being examined

interval_years.quote: Certificates of registration as a professional engineer, and certificates of authority, shall be valid for a period of two years from the assigned date of renewal.

required.quote: At the time of renewal specified in Section 6795 or 6796, the board shall administer an assessment of the certificate holder to reinforce the certificate holder's knowledge of state laws and the board's rules and regulations.

available.quote: the board, upon application therefor, on its prescribed form, and the payment of the fee fixed by this chapter, may issue a certificate of registration as a professional engineer, without written examination, to any person holding a certificate of registration issued to him or her by any state or country when the applicant's qualifications meet the requirements of this chapter and rules established by the board.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a certificate of registration from another state or country, meet California's qualifications, and have passed an equivalent second division examination. Board shall not require comity applicant to meet any requirement not required of California applicants.
requirements.quote: The board shall not require a comity applicant to meet any requirement not required of California applicants.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime substantially related to the qualifications, functions, and duties of a licensed professional engineer.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conviction of a crime substantially related to the qualifications, functions, and duties of a licensed professional engineer, in which case the certified record of conviction shall be conclusive evidence thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any deceit, misrepresentation, or fraud in the licensee's practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any deceit, misrepresentation, or fraud in their practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any negligence or incompetence in the licensee's practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any negligence or incompetence in their practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A breach or violation of a contract to provide professional engineering services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A breach or violation of a contract to provide professional engineering services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in obtaining the certificate as a professional engineer.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in obtaining their certificate as a professional engineer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting any person in the violation of any provision of this chapter or any board regulation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting any person in the violation of any provision of this chapter or any regulation adopted by the board pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: For a licensee serving as a qualified professional certifier, making a false statement in a certification submission.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For a licensee who serves as a qualified professional certifier, as defined in Section 66345.1 of the Government Code, making any false statement in a certification submission pursuant to Chapter 14 (commencing with Section 66345) of Division 1 of Title 7 of the Government Code.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A violation in the course of practice of a rule or regulation of unprofessional conduct adopted by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation in the course of the practice of professional engineering of a rule or regulation of unprofessional conduct adopted by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A violation of any provision of this chapter or any other law relating to or involving the practice of professional engineering.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of any provision of this chapter or any other law relating to or involving the practice of professional engineering.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a licensee to report required events (convictions, settlements, judgments) to the board in the time and manner required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a licensee to report to the board in the time and manner required by this section shall be grounds for disciplinary action.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A current organization record form shall be filed with the board for all businesses engaged in rendering civil, electrical, or mechanical engineering services.

definition_quote.value: refers to a person engaged in the professional practice of rendering service or creative work requiring education, training and experience in engineering sciences and the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical and engineering sciences in such professional or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning or design of public or private utilities, structures, machines, processes, circuits, buildings, equipment or projects, and supervision of construction for the purpose of securing compliance with specifications and design for any such work.
definition_quote.quote: refers to a person engaged in the professional practice of rendering service or creative work requiring education, training and experience in engineering sciences and the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical and engineering sciences in such professional or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning or design of public or private utilities, structures, machines, processes, circuits, buildings, equipment or projects, and supervision of construction for the purpose of securing compliance with specifications and design for any such work.

methods_authorized.quote: consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning or design of public or private utilities, structures, machines, processes, circuits, buildings, equipment or projects, and supervision of construction for the purpose of securing compliance with specifications and design for any such work.

covers_land_surveying.quote: Civil engineers registered prior to January 1, 1982, shall be authorized to practice all land surveying as defined in Chapter 15 (commencing with Section 8700) of Division 3.

covers_geology.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Board for Professional Engineers, Land Surveyors, and Geologists, which consists of 15 members.

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: An applicant for certification as an engineer-in-training shall, upon meeting all of the requirements prescribed in subdivisions (a) and (b) of Section 6751, be issued a certificate as an engineer-in-training.

postgraduate_degree_experience_credit_ye.quote: May at its discretion give credit as qualifying experience not in excess of five years, for a postgraduate degree in a school of engineering with a board approved undergraduate or postgraduate curriculum.

responsible_charge_defined.quote: The phrase "responsible charge of work" means the independent control and direction, by the use of initiative, skill, and independent judgment, of the investigation or design of professional engineering work or the direct engineering control of such projects.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: All civil engineering plans and specifications that are permitted or that are to be released for construction shall bear the signature and seal or stamp of the licensee and the date of signing and sealing or stamping.

seal_document_types.quote: All civil (including structural and geotechnical) engineering plans, calculations, specifications, and reports

firm_practice_allowed.quote: This chapter does not prohibit one or more civil, electrical, or mechanical engineers from practicing or offering to practice, within the scope of their license, civil (including geotechnical and structural), electrical, or mechanical engineering as a sole proprietorship, partnership, limited liability partnership, firm, or corporation

exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A subordinate to a civil, electrical or mechanical engineer licensed under this chapter, or a subordinate to a civil, electrical or mechanical engineer exempted from licensure under this chapter, insofar as he or she acts solely in that capacity, is exempt from licensure under the provisions of this chapter.

code_of_ethics_in_statute.quote: The board may adopt rules and regulations of professional conduct that are not inconsistent with state and federal law. The rules and regulations may include definitions of incompetence and negligence. Every person who holds a license or certificate issued by the board pursuant to this chapter shall be governed by these rules and regulations.

multi_license_reporting_required.quote: A licensee shall report to the board in writing the occurrence of any of the following events that occurred on or after January 1, 2008, within 90 days of the date the licensee has knowledge of the event

retired_status_license_available.quote: The board shall issue, upon application and payment of the fee established by Section 6799, a retired license (registration), to an engineer who has been licensed by the board for a minimum of 5 years within California and a minimum of 20 years within the United States or territory of the United States
